pages.title: The end of the week · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in Denver. Jake sits at his desk in a quiet office. He has a big spreadsheet and an invoice to send. The deadline is five o’clock, and the clock is slow. He yawns and drinks his third coffee. His coworker Nora walks over with a happy face.
“Finally, it’s Friday! You look exhausted.” says Nora. “Yes, my week was long, but good.” says Jake. “Do you finish the spreadsheet before the deadline?” says Nora.

pages.title: The end of the week · 3/3
paragraphs: “Can I invite my brother too? He loves trivia.” says Jake. “Sure, the more the better. See you at the door!” says Nora. Jake smiles for the first time today. He sends the invoice and closes the spreadsheet. At five, they leave the office together. The sun is orange behind the mountains. On the rooftop, people sit at long tables with pens and papers. Jake feels tired, but happy, and the night is just starting.
